mechanics.title: Statistics GUI
mechanics.description: Search, filter, sort and group statistics. Item and mob stats are shown in a grid. Statistics files can be saved, loaded, viewed in tabs and shared with other players.

qol: Search, filter, sort and group statistics
Visual grid for item and mob stats
Save/load statistics files in tabs and share them
Option for GUI mobs to follow the cursor (client config)
commands_and_keybinds: /statistics (optional; can be disabled with the 'Register commands' config option): edit or clear player statistics and read stat values; usable from datapacks. Permission level presumed operator; check in-game.
getting_started: Open the statistics screen from the pause menu (Statistics) as usual.
editor_notes: The /statistics command is only partly described (lang strings: edit stat, clear stats, read value). The mod also has an optional online API endpoint and developer PSA chat messages (configurable). Depends on TCDCommons.
name: Better Statistics Screen
summary: Replaces the vanilla statistics screen with a searchable, filterable, sortable and groupable one. Item and mob statistics appear in a visual grid, with mobs rendered on screen.
